Brazen

BRAY-zun -- from Old English braes, 'brass': bold as brass, with a face as hard as the metal. · adjective

Hear It

What It Means

Brazen is bold and without shame.

In a brazen move, the con artist returned to sell fake tickets outside the very stadium that had banned him.

Worked Example

Caught cheating with notes taped inside his water bottle, a student doesn't blush or apologize -- he grins, shrugs, and asks the teacher if she can prove it.

That shameless, unblushing boldness is exactly what brazen describes. Unlike 'brave,' which is boldness in a good cause, brazen boldness comes without any sense of shame.

How Brazen Sits Among Its Neighbors

Synonyms — open each to see how it differs

bold

bold: confident and daring

shameless

shameless: feeling no shame at all

audacious

audacious: recklessly daring

Antonyms

bashful

bashful: shy and easily embarrassed

sheepish

sheepish: embarrassed from having done something wrong

How Strong Is It? — bold → brazen → shameless

bold vs. brazen

bold vs. brazen: Bold is the neutral base that brazen builds on -- boldness can be admirable, while brazen boldness always carries a whiff of shamelessness.

shameless vs. brazen

shameless vs. brazen: Shameless is the very heart of brazen, and arguably blunter: brazen emphasizes the daring act done openly, while shameless emphasizes the missing conscience behind it.

Build the Word

The pieces

root — braz-

root — braz-: brass (Old English (braes))

suffix — -en

suffix — -en: made of (Old English)

Put it together

Put it together: Old English braesen meant 'made of brass' -- someone brazen acts 'bold as brass,' with a face as hard as the metal, the same root behind brass and brassy.

Use the root in a new word: brassy

Use the root in a new word: brassy: The talk-show host's brassy interviewing style startled her more polite guests.

Root Check

Word Choice

Brazen almost always signals disapproval -- 'a brazen lie,' 'a brazen theft' -- describing wrongdoing carried out openly, without even a pretense of shame.
